title: The Last Ember
description: A crimson, ivory-horned dragon shelters a glowing egg beneath immense black bat wings. Her curved neck lowers a watchful, open-jawed face over the clutch, and her long armoured tail curls around its cradle.

sections.name: Four sculpted legs and hooked talons
Arched neck and segmented breast armour
Watchful face, open jaws and curved ivory horns
Immense swept wings on curved shoulder mounts
